page.notes: Coin legends are Greek and are copied as printed. Each line of a legend is shown after " / ". Reading the coins is difficult. The letters are small and partly worn, and the reverse legends run around the rim, so letter order may be off, and every doubtful letter is marked [?]. Coin 10 has no legible legend. Wear and the lower edge of the plate may hide further letters. A faint printer's mark is at the bottom centre of the plate. It is not transcribed. A stamp in the lower right corner is also not transcribed.
